answer: Before an identity can draw a grading seat, it locks a refundable bond and posts a work cipher equal to the hash of its last sixteen attested nonces with their ledger timestamps. A later panel, drawn by sortition, recomputes that hash from public data only. When several fresh addresses echo one operator's inter-arrival gaps or share a root, the panel slashes the common bond and drops the seats. A genuine trail stays distinct through the review zenith; a cloned farm cannot.
